meta.description: Bulk-query Ensembl BioMart (and other BioMart instances) for cross-database ID mapping, gene/transcript/exon coordinates, and ortholog tables. Use when batch-converting Ensembl IDs to other namespaces (HGNC, RefSeq, UniProt, Entrez), pulling gene coordinate tables for thousands of genes, or building ortholog wide-tables across species.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated DOIs/PMIDs/p-values/trial results across any of the 7 inputs; every returned value (HGNC IDs, gene coordinates, ortholog calls, GO terms) was cross-checked against known real biology across independent live runs.

practice_boundaries.detail: No diagnostic/prescriptive medical conclusions; operates on population-level reference genome data (Ensembl BioMart), not individual patient data. No disclaimer required.

methodological_ground.detail: Query design is methodologically sound where it works (correct filter/attribute semantics now, correct one2one ortholog logic, correct long-format GO join). The two newly-found gaps (scale limit on ID-list filters, broken Ensembl-Genomes host-swap claim) are code-usability/documentation-accuracy defects, not methodological fallacies -- scored under static Correctness and M4 instead.

code_usability.detail: Both original P0s are genuinely fixed and independently reproduced: the flagship bulk-ID-mapping pattern and shipped example, the GO-annotation pattern, and the coordinate-table pattern all run end-to-end with correct real biology at realistic small/chromosome-level scale. Code is not broadly unrunnable. One real gap found this session (query_raw()'s GET-based transport 414s at ~2000+ IDs, undermining the Skill's own '5,000 IDs' claim) is scale-specific to one pattern, produces a clear catchable error rather than silent corruption, and is reported as a P1 recommendation rather than a veto trigger.

functional_suitability.note: Completeness/Correctness improved substantially: all 5 regression patterns plus both shipped examples now run end-to-end with real biology (both original P0s confirmed fixed). Two claims still fail in practice: the Goal text's '5,000 Ensembl Gene IDs' scale claim (414 at 2066 IDs) and the newly-promoted 'swap host for Ensembl Genomes' claim (Dataset NOT FOUND, reproduced via pybiomart's own ds.query() too).

reliability.note: query_raw()'s outage-page guard is real and independently verified across 5 canned response shapes (unit test, no false positives). Plain HTTP errors (429/500/414) from pybiomart's own raise_for_status() propagate as uncaught, undocumented exceptions outside query_raw()'s guarded/documented error surface.

performance_context.note: SKILL.md 360 lines, usage-guide.md trimmed in this fix's redundancy pass (removed restated 'What the Agent Will Do'/'Tips' sections), examples/ cleanly separated.

agent_usability.note: Consistent terminology (attribute vs filter now carefully distinguished throughout). Failure modes/Common errors tables are extensive (9 entries) but do not mention the GET-based URL-length ceiling that breaks the flagship pattern at the Skill's own advertised scale.

human_usability.note: Natural trigger language; discovery-first guidance pattern (Input 3) remains the single most useful workflow in the Skill.

security.note: No credentials, no destructive operations, public reference data only. Filter values confirmed safely XML-escaped for special characters (&, <, >, ") via an offline round-trip test.

maintainability.note: query_raw() is duplicated byte-identically in SKILL.md and both examples (confirmed via diff -- no drift yet, but 3 places to update for any future fix to the shared helper). Redundancy pass cleanly trimmed usage-guide.md's restated sections.

agent_specific.note: Precise triggering, correct progressive disclosure, strong 'Related Skills' composability section, fully idempotent read-only queries, and a working BioMart-vs-REST decision-matrix escape hatch.

recommendations.title: Bulk ID-mapping fails at the Skill's own advertised scale (414 Request-URI Too Large)
recommendations.problem: query_raw() calls ds.get(), which is pybiomart's ServerBase.get() -- a plain HTTP GET with the entire XML query embedded in the URL. At 2066 real Ensembl gene IDs (~33KB filter value alone), Ensembl rejects the request with 414 Request-URI Too Large. SKILL.md's own Goal text advertises '5,000 Ensembl Gene IDs' and usage-guide.md's Quick Start example says '8,000 Ensembl Gene IDs' -- both would fail the same way, worse.
recommendations.root_cause: query_raw() inherits pybiomart's GET-based transport unchanged; nothing in the fix's new helper switches to POST or chunks large ID lists client-side.
recommendations.fix: Either build the query_raw() request as an HTTP POST (BioMart's martservice endpoint accepts POST for the same XML payload) or chunk ID lists above a safe size (empirically ~500-1000 IDs) into multiple queries joined client-side, and correct the '5,000'/'8,000 IDs' claims in SKILL.md and usage-guide.md to state the real, tested limit.

recommendations.title: Ensembl Genomes 'swap the host' claim does not work for a real dataset
recommendations.problem: SKILL.md's tool listing (promoted into the main document by this fix, moved from usage-guide.md's Tips) claims 'Non-vertebrate species: swap the host for the Ensembl Genomes BioMart, e.g. Server(host='http://plants.ensembl.org')'. Querying the real athaliana_eg_gene dataset this way fails with 'Dataset NOT FOUND', via both query_raw() and pybiomart's own built-in ds.query() -- so it is not a query_raw()-specific bug, but the claim itself is unverified and inaccurate as a one-line instruction.
recommendations.root_cause: The claim was carried over/relocated from usage-guide.md's Tips without being run against a real Ensembl Genomes dataset before being given more prominence in SKILL.md's main tool listing.
recommendations.fix: Either verify a working end-to-end Ensembl Genomes example (may need a different martservice path/virtual schema handling than the main Ensembl host) before shipping it as a one-line claim, or caveat it clearly as unverified / requiring additional configuration.

recommendations.title: query_raw()'s error guard can't distinguish a genuine live outage from a degenerate query
recommendations.problem: An empty ID-list filter and an all-unknown-ID filter both surfaced the same generic 'non-TSV response' RuntimeError that the guard also raises for a genuine service outage. An agent catching this exception has no reliable way to tell 'retry me later' from 'this query itself was malformed, don't retry.'
recommendations.root_cause: query_raw() uses one exception type and message for every non-TSV/empty-body case, regardless of cause.
recommendations.fix: Raise a distinct exception (or include a machine-checkable flag/code) for a genuinely empty response versus an HTML outage page, and document pre-flight validation (e.g. reject an empty filter list before sending the request) so agents get a clear, immediate error instead of a round trip to the server.
